verdict.rationale: mParticle is a customer data platform with an AI-assisted audience feature, so letting that assistant connect to external MCP servers is a plausible capability and the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP, a tool-plugin mechanism, or connecting external tool servers to its AI features. The integrations, custom-integration and audience-output docs describe data forwarding to vendors, which is a different capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
